import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
T=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('RGB'))[:,:,0]<80
C=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/output/final_canvas_cam.png').convert('RGB'))
# Flat overhead camera maps sheet into approx [68,956] x [68,956]. Sample camera mask back onto target raster.
# Resize exactly to the raster, like viewing the paper through canvas_cam.
cm=(C[:,:,0]<80)
cm=cm[68:956,68:956]
M=np.asarray(Image.fromarray((cm*255).astype('uint8')).resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.NEAREST))>0
best=[]
for dy in range(-23,24):
 for dx in range(-23,24):
  # shift M by (dy,dx)
  ys=slice(max(0,dy),min(1024,1024+dy)); xs=slice(max(0,dx),min(1024,1024+dx))
  my=slice(max(0,-dy),min(1024,1024-dy)); mx=slice(max(0,-dx),min(1024,1024-dx))
  a=M[ys,xs]; b=T[my,mx]
  inter=np.logical_and(a,b).sum(); union=np.logical_or(a,b).sum()
  best.append((inter/union,dy,dx,inter,union))
for item in sorted(best,reverse=True)[:15]: print(item)
print('target area',T.sum(),'actual area',M.sum(),'unshift IoU',np.logical_and(T,M).sum()/np.logical_or(T,M).sum())
# Extents in actual raster
ys,xs=np.where(M); print('actual bounds',xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max())

import numpy as np

for dy in [-12,-9,-6,0,6,9,12]:
 for dx in [-3,0,3]:
  shifted=np.zeros_like(M)

  I=(T&shifted).sum(); U=(T|shifted).sum(); print(dy,dx,'IoU',round(I/U,3),'P',round(I/shifted.sum(),3),'R',round(I/T.sum(),3),'areas',shifted.sum())
